# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository rules in `AGENTS.md` as the canonical source of project guidance.

- Keep all code and documentation in technical English.
- Keep the solution aligned with the technical challenge scope.
- Prefer simple, maintainable Python patterns over over-engineered abstractions.
- Do not add business features that are not explicitly required in this challenge.
- Keep the project ready for deterministic test execution and future implementation tasks.
